NovelName: A Certain Yandere Girl’s Treatment Plan
Intro: If a girl falls for you with unprovoked, near-maniacal zeal, you can pretty much bet she’s got that yandere streak. Lamenting why fate chose you, you can only set foot on a road of no return—to cure Terminal Yandere Syndrome before your life tumbles into deeper tragedy.

NovelName: After My Defeat, the Succubus Empress Cursed Me into a Little Succubus
Intro:
I Was Human Once...

The demon I was supposed to assassinate is now holding me in her arms. “Granddaughter, you’re awake?”

“Granddaughter?” Still utterly dumbfounded, I finally realized, “Wait... how did I turn into a succubus?!”

“D-Don’t come any closer! Eek!” Trembling all over, now a cute little succubus, I stared at the breathtakingly beautiful demon before me in fear.

NovelName: I Was Reborn as Their Dream Girl
Intro:
“She really is his new girlfriend, so please take good care of her, okay~”

“Once the rental period is over, we’ll go our separate ways and owe each other nothing.”

“I’m not putting it on, okay? This is my real voice. Is it really… cute?”

“No need to guess—this is the fake voice I specifically trained for you lolicon types.”

“That anime? I love it! The male lead is such a gentle person…”

Whether it’s a harem or pure romance, if you pay me, my interests are as broad as the entire SCP Foundation.

This is a story about a middle-aged man who is reborn as a beautiful girl and keeps learning and growing in order to make money…

NovelName: Reborn as a Beautiful Girl, I Get Put in My Place Every Single Day
Intro:
After a tragic car accident, I was reborn in the body of a beautiful girl.

The original owner had toyed with a rich, elegant older beauty, and when the truth came out, she was forced to repay the debt with her own body.

Don’t panic. First, offer a meek apology. Then take the initiative and ask what kind of compensation she wants. And finally, kindly remind her to take care of her health.

“I’m sorry, but what you want... is that kind of thing, right? It’s just that, with your level of skill, I’m a little worried.”

That was what I said, in all sincerity, despite my slight difficulty with communication.

I have no idea why she flew into such a towering rage. I only know that from that day on, life began to hurt.

Lighthearted and easygoing, no heavy angst.

NovelName: As a Demon Hunter, I Was Forced to Marry the Vampire Queen
Intro:
As a Demon Hunter, my very first mission after Awakening was to infiltrate a school and investigate reports of monsters hiding among the students.

But the moment I stepped inside, I was captured by the student council president—who just so happened to be the Queen of the Vampires. And waiting for me besides her were terrifying devils, ancient gods, succubi, fox spirits...

W-Waaah... please, don’t eat me...

...

If you really must... then please... be gentle... QAQ

Girls’ Love, extra sweet, HE, single heroine

NovelName: I Saved the World and Ended Up with a Fox-Spirit Wife
Intro:
In a frozen prison, he comes face to face with the fox-eared beauty he saved five years ago. From that moment, a seed takes root in the heart of the man once hailed as the strongest hero.

Revenge? Rescue? Trifles. So long as the fox maiden stands by his side, nothing else will ever be a problem.

NovelName: Chronicles of the Wicked Lady
Intro: After Being Burned Alive by My Sister and Her Lover, I Decided to Build a Mecha for Revenge!

NovelName: The Dragon Princess Villainess Won’t Be Bullied by a Yandere Heroine
Intro:
A shameless god conned me into a silver-haired, scarlet-eyed villainess—a Dragon Princess—and I even accidentally bound the heroine and stashed her in the basement. I, Su Qingqian, just wanted to clear my name.

Standing before me is a poised, heartbreakingly demure big-sister type with her cultivation sealed—she’s also the future protagonist’s fiancée.

Choose: go all-in and make the brainwashing one-and-done? Record a naughty little video for easy blackmail? Long live the scoundrel.

I had no choice before; now I only want to be a good person.

Yet the harder I try to steer the heroines off their corruption routes, the more dangerous their eyes become when they look at me.

Bad women, don’t you dare trick me—I bite. Back off! What, you plan to ride the dragon?

NovelName: Rising from the Coffin—Why Won’t That Wicked Woman Leave Me Be?
Intro:
Yuri + Everyone’s a Villain + Full Capture

After sleeping in a coffin for twenty-three years, the day the lid creaked open, Kisaragi Ci knew something was off.

Not only had she woken as a woman, but the people from her past had all climbed beyond her reach.

Her old partner? Now the Police Commissioner.
The little sister she once doted on? An academy headmistress.
Even her sworn enemy? The power behind a colossal conglomerate.

Ci thought that, after waking, her path would never cross theirs again—until those women started appearing before her, one after another.

“This time, don’t even think about running.”
“I won’t let you slip away again…”
“Kisaragi, you wouldn’t want anyone to find out, would you…?”

Kisaragi Ci: I’m exhausted. Don’t @ me.

NovelName: Could you please spare me, my dear sisters?
Intro:
"Betty, I want to have a baby dragon with you!"
Bexia: "No, Sis Yulina, stay away from me!"
"Does Betty want to go drink flower tea with me?"
Bexia: "Sis  Season, don't suddenly appear and scare me."
"You sluts always seduce Betty. As his wife, I need to defend my position. Asreya and Nesi, get rid of them!"
Looking at Sister Carlos taking out her bow of destruction, Bexia wanted to immediately stpe her, but a black hole suddenly appeared under his feet causing him to fall .
Bexia: "Sister Cloud, you attacked me again..."

NovelName: After the dragon was taken away by the princess
Intro:
"Your race?"
"...Dragon."
"Your gender?"
"...Can't you tell?"
"I surely can before, but now there are crossdressers everywhere and all sorts of gender transformations, and it's hard to tell who's a man or woman anymore... Forget it, never mind. a male... Your age?"
"...Two hundred and four."
"Why are you here? Did you get captured for kidnapping a princess again?"
"Kidnapping your ass! I'm the one who got kidnapped by your princess and brought back here!"

NovelName: After Reincarnating as the Villainess, I Just Want to Save Myself
Intro:
A noble-born girl reincarnated as a Heretic God will resort to every low, shameless, deceitful trick to keep the Church from capturing her. But if none of that works?

Then the black-haired girl will shout, “Grab the money and run, Yuna!”

“No—don’t! Let’s try scamming them one more time!” The pink-haired girl clutches her arm.

Come see when the heroine finally loses every last shred of reason.

NovelName: Reborn as a young dragon girl by meeting the silver dragon queen
Intro:
How many times in life can you have such alpaca-type surprises? Mo Li, a poor human teenager, becomes a dragon lady after being kidnapped by a silver-haired dragon lady. 
"In conclusion, your mother, also known as my sister, is the royal family of dragons." 
The stunningly beautiful cherry-white haired dragon lady had no expression on her face. "What the hell, is my mother a female dragon who likes to have outsiders to be dragon riders, that's not funny ...... eh eh! Ouch!" 
"If you talk nonsense again, I'll throw you into the pot and fry you into rotten meat." 
The beautiful dragon lady's expression blackened.

NovelName: Dad is the Strongest Ally of the Legendary Hero
Intro:
I have a daughter who is 12 years old this year.
Not to brag, my daughter is definitely the cutest in the world.
But her excessive cuteness brings me a lot of trouble as her father.
The problem is that there are many suitors around my daughter.
So here I want to tell those who plan to pursue my daughter: Defeat Me First!
This is a daily story about the Final Boss dad and his adorable daughter.

NovelName: My Bro Became a Girl, and She Insists on Being My Personal Assistant
Intro:
Chu Nan has lived twice—both transmigrated and reborn—and these days he’s just a small-time streamer with a hundred thousand fans.

He figured coasting through this life wouldn’t be so bad, until a sudden twist shattered his peace.

Out of nowhere, a system binds to him, promising to grant his heart’s desires—and even drops a breathtaking beauty onto his bed. Since when do systems ship with a bride?

Before he can celebrate, the system drops another bomb: this “wife” is Xiao Han, his childhood friend—the one he was so close to they practically shared a pair of shorts.

Faced with a maiden of a hundred charms, Chu Nan wrestles with himself for a long, painful beat… then finally asks his first question: “Wanna do it?”

NovelName: The Virtual Idol My Archnemesis Stans Turns Out to Be Me
Intro:
A Socially Anxious Shut-In Blacked Out for a Moment… and Reincarnated as a Cute Girl? And Became a Virtual Streamer, Too?

Reach One Million Followers Within a Year—or Turn Into a Trash Can?

Yamero~

I’ve decided—starting today, I’m going to become the brightest, most beloved beautiful girl of them all!

…Wait, something’s off. Why is my manipulative honor-student deskmate—the one I hate most—also stanning me as his one and only?

One day—

The deskmate cornered the girl against the wall, holding her phone with a crooked grin.

“My, so you’re Ari-chan after all?”

“W-Wait, please go easy on me…”

“How could I do that? I’ve spent so many gifts on you already. If you don’t marry me, this is going to get very hard to settle.”

NovelName: The Supreme Blade and the Twelve Sword Maidens
Intro:
Not a Game, but the Tale of Two Worlds Intertwined

This is no game, but the story of two worlds merging into one: the real world, and a realm of magic.

O Tao, the world champion, gazed at his younger sister, frail and withering like a dead branch before his eyes. “Little Sis! No matter the cost, I’ll save you.”

“My lord father, you’re finally awake!” At the sight of the silver-haired girl by his bedside, he realized this was not a game, but another world. She was alive, warm, and real.

“You’ve been to the other world too, haven’t you?” the mixed-blood campus belle said with a smile as she picked up the game helmet and put it on.

“Mister, in the name of the princess, I challenge you to a knight’s duel!” The golden-haired princess lowered her longsword, magic flickering along its blade.

“Little Brother, I’m with you!” The domineering business queen wrapped her arms around him from behind.

“Hehe, I’m going to drain you dry~” The vampire princess pounced on him with a wicked grin.

Standing atop a hillside, O Tao turned his back on the glittering metropolis of neon and indulgence, and faced the magical continent reflected at the edge of the heavens.

“The game begins.”

NovelName: Reborn as a Tentacle Monster—What Will You Do in the Otherworld?
Intro:
Kid, I am the God of Tentacles. To let the boundless love of our tentacle kin wash over the otherworld, the glorious task of opening a harem there falls to you. Of course, before that, I’ll turn you into one of us. You may thank me now, kid.

The hell with your “thanks”! I don’t want to become a tentacle monster!

Bastard, just you wait...

Glurp!!??

NovelName: I Was Reincarnated with Superpowers
Starting Over for a Second Run—Who’s Still in the Mood to Fall in Love With You?
Intro:
A Slow-Burn Campus Romance, Clean and Drama-Free

“Mr. Chen, rumor has it that after your rebirth, you devoted yourself to studying hard and building a business from the ground up, never once bothering with romance—and that’s how you achieved your success today. Is that true?”

“Of course. Dating? Even dogs wouldn’t bother!”

“Then may I ask—there are also rumors that you have a very, very close friend, so close that the two of you once hoped to bear the fruit of your friendship?”

“Impossible. We’re innocent—utterly innocent!”

“Very well. Then what about the rumor that you have a wealthy white moonlight willing to lower her score just to attend the same university as you?”

“That’s impossible too. I just owe her money—I’ve got no intention of selling myself!”

“Then is it true that you’re being wrapped around the finger of a certain bad woman?”

“Th-That… hss... how about we just go with the first two rumors instead?”

NovelName: After I Kept My Distance, the Heroines Descended into Yandere Madness
Intro:
After Becoming the Distasteful Male Character in a Dark R16 Heroine Game—the Only One Capable of Replenishing the Heroines’ Mana—Hall Felt His Life Was Hanging by a Thread.

Because his entire purpose in the game was to serve as a mana battery whenever the chosen heroines were outmatched, helping them power up and level beyond their limits.

And in every route, he was ultimately doomed to die.

To save himself, he resolved to keep his distance from all the heroines.

Yet before long, the Demon God’s forsaken heir, the Church’s holy maiden, the Empress of the North, and the elven princess all came to him one after another, utterly ignoring the game’s original setting, and confessed their love.

But Hall knew the truth.

Little by little, they would all turn into dangerously obsessive yanderes—and when that happened, their threat level would skyrocket.

NovelName: My Wife Wants a Divorce
Intro:
I Once Had a Wife—Sexy, Stunning, Long-Legged.
But I didn’t cherish her; only after losing her did I finally understand...

Single life is damn sweet—game whenever I want, no one nagging me about drinking, no curfew at night. No daily cooking or dishwashing; I can order takeout, let friends crash at my place...

But when I’m sick, no one’s there. Day to day, no one to keep me company. Holed up at home, the loneliness gnaws; at night I sleep alone. I cook for myself, eat by myself, wash my own clothes...

On the third day after the divorce, I miss her, miss her, miss her~

My lady, I was wrong. Let’s remarry!

NovelName: I'm the Hero's Priest
Intro:
I Became Lord Hero’s Priestess—Yay!

Day One, the Hero: “This is the new paladin girl.”
Day Two, the Hero: “This is the new mage girl. You girls be nice to each other, okay?”
Day Three, the Hero: “And this is the new archer girl…”

Me: …………

A heroine’s-eye view of a so-called Hero building himself a harem. At its heart, this is an anti-harem tale.

NovelName: Claim your Otherworld Survival Guide by clicking here
Intro:
If you're unfortunate enough to travel through time, follow these rules to survive:

First: Don't provoke a queen you can't defeat, for example, one with different colored pupils who's strangling your neck.

Second: If there's a captured child who needs your protection, you must protect well, like a captured orphan of the  demon king.

Third: If you fall in love with that cold female knight, be prepared for the exhaustion of dealing with a straight woman and facing a series of female elves and mothers-in-law.

Fourth: Prepare medicines, whether it's for leg injuries or your body.

NovelName: This guard has the night shift, but always wants to sleep
Intro: Welcome to watch the epic TV drama "How a Righteous Sheriff Became a Scum" and the radio drama "How a Pretty Girl Became a Cat Girl."

NovelName: Wicked Words of the Savior Demon Lord
Intro: At Long Last, the Villain Finds His Happy Ending—A Long Road, Finally Rewarded…

NovelName: Turns Out I’m That Kind of Hero!
Intro:
Q1：Could a cross-dressing boy be even cuter than a real girl?
Q2：What, unless it’s constipation—the most bogus way to die—it doesn’t count?!
Q3：Besides pummeling the Demon Lord, what else is a Hero good for?
Q4：Sure, I’m cute—but I draw death to me… what the hell is this?
Q5：Ahem, this is absolutely a serious, proper novel!
Q6：Harem? No! I want a “Harem Kingdom”!

NovelName: The Love Puppeteer and the Green Tea Girl: A War of Hearts
The Demonesses I Saved Keep Knocking at My Door
Didn't We Agree You'd Only Be My Fake Girlfriend?
Intro: To help the lovestruck underclassman who confessed to him focus on her studies and thrive, Lin Shu strikes a No-Dating Alliance with Su Nuan—the icy heiress equally hounded by romance woes. They sign a contract, fake-date, and fend off suitors for one another. But somewhere along the way, the script goes awry… as if the act isn’t just an act anymore.

NovelName: Too Busy Studying to Fall in Love
Intro:
A middle-aged, chronically single programmer from the Celestial Empire finds his soul transmigrated into the body of a Japanese delinquent high schooler, with only one goal in mind: to “study abroad back home.”

A delinquent? Not anymore.
A girlfriend? Unnecessary.
Any guy looking to pick a fight is nothing but a heretical obstacle.
Any girl trying to lure him into romance is but a pretty skeleton beneath the skin.

Eternity stretches like a long, endless night; only diligent study is the righteous path.

Hopelessly addicted to studying.
No dating. No death flags.

NovelName: The Darkened Beauty Turned Out to Be Me
Intro:
A Yuri Top/POV story from the eyes of a yandere girl.

I want to possess you.

I want you to have no one by your side but me.

Anyone who gets close to you will be removed.

If you try to run, you will be punished.

No matter what it takes—filthy, wicked, despicable, shameless means—I’ll use them all, just to keep you by my side forever and ever.

My name is Lu Lele, a beautiful girl forced by a strange god to play the role of a yandere.

Tell me, my dearest girl—

—are you ready to spend eternity with me?

I guarantee it’ll be blissful.

NovelName: Only When They Understood Their Feelings Had the Knight Already Reincarnated as a Young Fox
Intro:
As the Six Ancient Divine Clans waned and mankind rose to power, the continent was plunged into endless strife, its thrones changing hands without cease.

In that age of chaos, when the people had no peace to live by, an unknown knight rose to prominence. After more than twenty years of war, he brought the era of turmoil to an end, and yet...

He slew a cruel tyrant and safeguarded the Empire’s young princess until she could ascend the throne, only to have his own power stripped away.

He rescued an elven princess and defended the elven realm from being devoured by war, only to be shunned at every turn by the elves.

He aided the Empress of Jiuzhou in purging treacherous ministers and securing her throne, only to be betrayed in the end.

He helped a fox-dancer of Sakura Dye cast off her lowborn status and rise to the rank of Chief Minister, yet to her he was nothing more than a stepping stone to be used and discarded.

He purged the kingdom of a plague of heretics, only to be burdened with crimes he never committed.

Watching this flourishing continent, now thriving and no longer in need of him, the knight quietly chose to withdraw once his work was done.

He had never sought anyone’s gratitude.

With peace under heaven, his purpose had already been fulfilled.

No longer young, he drew his sword and struck at an enemy he could never hope to defeat, using that final battle as the closing note of his life.

But he did not die. The demon fox bloodline within him saved his life. Forced to change sex, she resolved to sever all ties with her former life as a knight and live on quietly as an ordinary person.

What she did not know, however, was that the empresses and princesses who had once harbored all manner of feelings for him were already drowning in regret when they learned of his death...

NovelName: After We Broke Up, My Ex-Girlfriend Forced the Witch’s Secret Elixir Down My Throat
Intro:
A Wife Is a Wife, a Girlfriend Is a Girlfriend, Baby Is Baby, Darling Is Darling, You Are You—Everyone’s Different, Yet Somehow All the Same...

Mm. They’re All My One and Only.

NovelName: Shut Up, Hero—You’ll Get No Atonement from Me!
Intro:
What Do You Do When the Hero Accidentally Wrecks Your Hard-Won Planar Teleportation Array?

As a witch, Lacey has only one answer: revenge.

She can’t beat him head-on, but she can slip into the Hero’s party in disguise, make him fall hopelessly in love, then take the blade for him on purpose and die—leave him with a soul-deep ache and a regret that will haunt him for life.

But wait—who’s the poor sod whose instant noodles came without a seasoning packet who spread the rumor that she can resurrect the dead?

Now the Hero’s knocking on her door, demanding redemption? Hard pass!

NovelName: Now That I’m a Saintess, I Have to Defeat the Demon Lord Again Today
Intro:
"Come. Drink this, and you’ll be mine."

Lettia produced the violet elixir she’d prepared long ago, smiling brightly as she pressed it to the saintess’s lips.

It was the Moon’s Essence—a supreme treasure of demonkind, potent enough to drive even a succubus mad.

"No—don’t!"

Noah’s pretty face blanched. Bound and helpless, she could only watch as the maiden Demon Lord forced the potion past her lips.

Lettia believed that by nightfall, she would return to find a saintess fallen into darkness.

Yet she was the one who ended up bound, while the saintess—now a succubus—wore a delighted smile.

"Lord Demon King~"

"Shall we do something... delightful?~"

NovelName: Miss Vampire Is Anything but Cute
Intro: Gluttony is sin; immortality, a karmic curse. Ensnared by sin, denied deliverance. Where does the undying one’s journey end? In ashes and smoke—or… emerging from the cocoon as a butterfly?

NovelName: Pet Maiden of the Elven Queen
Intro:
- Xiao Qing, I think I had a dream—one where I slipped into another world and met someone who was your mirror image.
- Oh? Then it must have been a beautiful dream. (smiles)

NovelName: Guild Maiden's Ambition
Intro: Traveling through a fantasy world like a game, bidding farewell to my past gender, I become a charming little girl. The cultural differences in this otherworldly realm are quite troublesome, and those adventurers who defy common sense are rather awful. In a daze, I become a certain adventurer's guild maiden. In my daily life, it occasionally involves being cute, embarking on adventures, and pondering the meaning of life. Welcome to the Casa do Penedo, I am Miss Blue Nong, responsible for guiding everyone.

NovelName: Vampires and Knight
Intro: As a Saint Knight, I was lost and captured in an encounter with a bloodsucking species.  "Em, let you die? In your dreams! Accept my first embrace. In the future, we're gonna get along well. Oh~ my dear daughter." The Queen of Blood , a  little girl with silver hair picked up my chin slightly, smiled playfully, sharp fangs aimed at my neck. (The new book "Reborn as a Young Dragon Girl when Meeting the Silver Dragon Queen " has been online in winter(?_ _)? Dear readers, please support my new book～)
